roadmap.title: Short challenges and hidden interface achievements
roadmap.description: Complete the click-limited challenges, speed baking, and Hardcore in separate eligible runs. Between attempts, ascend and choose Born again before reincarnating. Collect the short menu achievements in the same legacy you plan to keep for a year.

roadmap.title: Start production and seasonal goals
roadmap.description: Buy buildings and upgrades and collect golden cookies. Begin ascending once you can earn prestige; do not wait for every production milestone listed here. These milestones continue through the later phases. Finish reindeer and wrinkler targets within one ascension because their counters reset.

roadmap.title: Develop prestige and finish ascension farming
roadmap.description: Spend heavenly chips on progression and train Krumblor. Once new ascensions build production quickly, finish the 1,000 prestige-gaining ascensions before chasing the largest cookie totals. Complete golden-cookie chain farming before starting a long market run. Later, combine production buffs with Click Frenzy and Big Cookie clicks to push cookie totals higher.

roadmap.title: Grow the Garden alongside long-term goals
roadmap.description: Develop the Garden while production progresses. Complete the seed log and perform the first sacrifice before bulk spending on level-10 buildings; further sacrifices can provide more lumps. All level-10 goals plus level-12 cursors need 1,123 lumps before extra minigame spending. The 25,000-hour overall estimate is elapsed calendar time including passive growth, not active playtime. Natural growth alone takes years; gardening can reduce that wait. Keep the same legacy for one year.

achievements.summary: Unlock all 34 Garden seeds.

guide.context: Raise farms to at least level 3 for the 3×3 plot needed by Juicy Queenbeet. Breed plants into empty tiles beside the listed parents, then harvest each new plant after it matures. Diagonal neighbors count. The groups organize mutation branches; the seeds can be collected in different orders.

collectibles.name: Baker's Wheat
collectibles.method: Available when the Garden opens.

collectibles.name: Thumbcorn
collectibles.method: Place two mature Baker's Wheat plants beside a shared empty tile.

collectibles.name: Cronerice
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile a mature Baker's Wheat neighbor and a mature Thumbcorn neighbor.

collectibles.name: Gildmillet
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Cronerice and Thumbcorn neighbors.

collectibles.name: Bakeberry
collectibles.method: Leave empty tiles beside pairs of mature Baker's Wheat plants until a Bakeberry grows.

collectibles.name: Ordinary Clover
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Baker's Wheat and Gildmillet neighbors.

collectibles.name: Golden Clover
collectibles.method: Use mature Baker's Wheat beside mature Gildmillet with shared empty tiles. This rarer mutation can replace the Ordinary Clover result.

collectibles.name: Shimmerlily
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Ordinary Clover and Gildmillet neighbors.

collectibles.name: Elderwort
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Shimmerlily and Cronerice neighbors.

collectibles.name: Whiskerbloom
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Shimmerlily and White Chocoroot neighbors.

collectibles.name: Chimerose
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Shimmerlily and Whiskerbloom neighbors.

collectibles.name: Nursetulip
collectibles.method: Place two mature Whiskerblooms beside a shared empty tile.

collectibles.name: Tidygrass
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Baker's Wheat and White Chocoroot neighbors.

collectibles.name: Everdaisy
collectibles.method: Surround an empty tile with three mature Tidygrass plants and three mature Elderwort plants.

collectibles.name: Meddleweed
collectibles.method: Leave the Garden empty on Dirt until Meddleweed appears.

collectibles.name: Brown Mold
collectibles.method: Manually uproot older Meddleweed until Brown Mold spores appear. Grow the new plant to maturity.

collectibles.name: White Mildew
collectibles.method: Leave a mature Brown Mold beside an empty tile. Keep at most one White Mildew in the surrounding tiles.

collectibles.name: Crumbspore
collectibles.method: Manually uproot older Meddleweed until Crumbspore appears. Grow the new plant to maturity.

collectibles.name: Doughshroom
collectibles.method: Place two mature Crumbspores beside a shared empty tile.

collectibles.name: Green Rot
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature White Mildew and Ordinary Clover neighbors.

collectibles.name: Keenmoss
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Green Rot and Brown Mold neighbors.

collectibles.name: Glovemorel
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Crumbspore and Thumbcorn neighbors.

collectibles.name: Cheapcap
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Crumbspore and Shimmerlily neighbors.

collectibles.name: Fool's Bolete
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Doughshroom and Green Rot neighbors.

collectibles.name: Wrinklegill
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Crumbspore and Brown Mold neighbors.

collectibles.name: Ichorpuff
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Elderwort and Crumbspore neighbors.

collectibles.name: Chocoroot
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile a mature Baker's Wheat neighbor and a Brown Mold neighbor of any age.

collectibles.name: White Chocoroot
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile one mature Chocoroot neighbor and one White Mildew neighbor of any age.

collectibles.name: Drowsyfern
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Chocoroot and Keenmoss neighbors.

collectibles.name: Wardlichen
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Cronerice and White Mildew neighbors.

collectibles.name: Queenbeet
collectibles.method: Give an empty tile mature Bakeberry and Chocoroot neighbors.

collectibles.name: Juicy Queenbeet
collectibles.method: Plant eight Queenbeets in a 3×3 ring with the center empty. Keep all eight mature together until the center mutates. This seed cannot be planted after collection.

collectibles.name: Duketater
collectibles.method: Place two mature Queenbeets beside a shared empty tile.

collectibles.name: Shriekbulb
collectibles.method: Place three Duketaters beside a shared empty tile. The Duketaters do not need to be mature.

guide.context: Start this farming loop once your prestige lets a new ascension afford 100 idleverses after buying only Heavenly chip secret. Each loop resets market progress and clears growing Garden plants, so finish any current-run goals first.

steps.text: Bake 1 billion cookies to unlock sugar lumps. Spend one lump to raise temples to level 1 and unlock the @mechanic{Pantheon}.
In the ascension tree, buy @item{How to bake your dragon} and @item{Inspired checklist}. Put @item{Lucky day} and @item{Serendipity} into permanent upgrade slots.
Reincarnate and buy @item{Heavenly chip secret}. Keep the other store upgrades unbought for now, except the dragon egg used below.
Buy 100 of every building type from cursors through idleverses, with 200 temples instead of 100.
Buy @item{A crumbly egg} and complete Krumblor’s training through the sacrifice of 100 idleverses. Equip @mechanic{Dragon Orbs}.
Slot @npc{Skruuia} in the Pantheon. Sell temples until Dragon Orbs creates a wrath cookie, keeping at least one temple. Remove Skruuia before clicking the cookie.

After @mechanic{Cookie Chain} appears, raise your bank by purchasing upgrades and buildings before the next natural spawn, roughly two minutes later. If the wrath cookie gives another effect, ascend and try a new run.
Click every cookie as the chain continues. If two cookies appear together, click both.
After the chain ends, ascend and repeat the loop until @mechanic{Golden cookies clicked} in Stats shows 27,777 all-time clicks.
steps.note: Natural golden and wrath cookies and Cookie Chain cookies count. The initial Dragon Orbs cookie, Force the Hand of Fate cookies and Cookie Storm drops do not.
